items.exampleEn: The manager will be back shortly, so please wait here.
items.exampleZh: 經理很快就會回來，請在這裡稍等。

items.exampleEn: The festival takes place annually in March.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶每年三月舉行。
你最近有見到 Kevin 嗎？

items.exampleEn: Missing a deadline can cost the company money.
items.exampleZh: 錯過截止期限可能讓公司損失金錢。

items.exampleEn: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the station.
items.exampleZh: 我們在車站附近的一間小旅館住了一晚。

items.exampleEn: Let's have lunch together sometime next week.
items.exampleZh: 我們下週找個時間一起吃午餐吧。

items.exampleEn: The shop on the corner has closed permanently.
items.exampleZh: 轉角那家店已經永久停業了。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your timely reply.
My former boss now works in Tainan.
items.exampleZh: 我以前的老闆現在在台南工作。

items.sentenceEn: My sister has been very busy lately because of her new job.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊最近因為新工作非常忙。

items.audioEn: The meeting has moved to Thursday, and the deadline is now next Monday.
items.audioZh: 會議改到星期四，截止期限現在改成下星期一。
items.questionZh: 截止期限改到什麼時候？

items.sentenceEn: We worked overnight to finish the plan on time.
items.sentenceZh: 我們熬夜工作，好準時完成計畫。

items.sentenceEn: Our office holds a party annually to thank all the staff.
items.sentenceZh: 我們辦公室每年辦一次派對，感謝所有員工。

items.stemEn: The bus will leave ____, so please get on now.
items.stemZh: 公車很快就要開了，所以請現在上車。

items.stemEn: Mr. Lin is my ____ teacher. He taught me ten years ago.
items.stemZh: 林先生是我以前的老師，他十年前教過我。

items.passageEn: Lately, Amy has been working very hard. Her company holds a design contest annually, and this year the deadline is next Friday. Her former manager, Mr. Lin, sent her a timely message with some useful advice. Amy plans to thank him sometime next month. On Tuesday, she stayed at the office overnight to finish her work. If she wins, she may move to the main office in Taipei permanently.
items.passageZh: 最近 Amy 工作非常努力。她的公司每年舉辦一次設計比賽，今年的截止日是下星期五。她以前的經理林先生及時傳了一則訊息給她，給了她一些有用的建議。Amy 打算下個月找個時間謝謝他。星期二，她在辦公室待了一整夜把工作做完。如果她贏了，她可能會永久搬到台北的總公司。

questions.questionZh: 誰及時給了 Amy 有用的建議？
如果 Amy 贏了比賽，她可能會怎樣？

referenceEn: She has often worked late lately.
Lately, she has often stayed late at work.
rubricZh: lately 常和現在完成式連用（例如 has worked、has been working）
「加班」可寫 work late、work overtime 等
lately 可放在句首、句尾等位置

items.instructionZh: 用 permanently 造一個句子，說說你希望永遠住在哪裡，或永遠保持什麼習慣。
referenceEn: I want to live in Tainan permanently.
I want to keep this healthy habit permanently.
rubricZh: 通常放在動詞片語後面（例如 live here permanently），也可放在動詞前
